summary: Import thunk for the Winsock2 ntohs (network to host short) function: reads the import-address-table pointer __imp_ntohs at 0x0059E2CC, calls it with the single u_short argument, and returns its result unchanged. Identified as ntohs by the ABI name, the function name and the __imp_ntohs IAT global.

operations.description: Call the imported ntohs through the IAT pointer __imp_ntohs (read at 0x0059E2CC) with the u_short argument.
Return the u_short result of the imported ntohs unchanged.
Consumed by network-endianness callers sub_561BF0 (0x00561BF0) and sub_563410 (0x00563410).
